blocks.text: Oxides woh binary compounds (do elements se bane compounds) hain jo oxygen ke doosre elements se react karne par bante hain. Oxides ko un ki properties ki buniyad par neutral, amphoteric, basic ya acidic types mein baanta jata hai.

Basic oxide woh oxide hai jo pani se mil kar alkali deta hai. Metals oxygen se react kar ke basic oxides banate hain. Yeh oxides aam taur par ionic hote hain. Group 1 aur 2 ke elements oxygen se react kar ke basic oxides banate hain, maslan Na₂O, CaO, BaO. Group 2 ke hydroxides ki pani mein hal hone ki solubility (salahiyat) group mein neeche barhti hai, is liye un ki alkalinity bhi neeche barhti hai.

Amphoteric oxides woh oxides hain jo acids aur bases dono se react karte hain, yani conditions (halaat) ke mutabiq acid ki tarah bhi aur base ki tarah bhi kaam kar sakte hain. Aluminium oxide (Al₂O₃) pani mein hal nahi hota, lekin hydrochloric acid se react kar ke aluminium chloride aur pani, aur sodium hydroxide se react kar ke sodium aluminate aur pani banata hai.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Pehli equation mein Al₂O₃ base ki tarah kaam kar raha hai (acid HCl se react), doosri mein acid ki tarah (base NaOH se react). Dono kaam karna hi amphoteric hona hai. Na₂Al₂O₄ ko aksar 2NaAlO₂ (sodium aluminate) bhi likha jata hai; dono ek hi cheez hain.

Acidic oxide woh oxide hai jo pani se mil kar acid deta hai. Non-metals oxygen se react kar ke acidic oxides banate hain, jin ke atoms covalent bonds se jure hote hain. Silicon dioxide bhi acidic oxide hai kyun ke yeh bases se react karta hai. Period 3 ke acidic oxides ki misalein: P₂O₃, P₂O₅, SO₃, SO₂.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab mein P₂O₃(s) + H₂O(l) → H₃PO₃(aq) chhapa hai, jo balanced nahi: baen taraf 2 P aur 4 O, daen taraf 1 P aur 3 O. Sahi: P₂O₃(s) + 3H₂O(l) → 2H₃PO₃(aq).
In oxides ke bases ke saath reactions yeh hain:

blocks.caption: Period 3 ke oxides
rows: Acid: AlCl₃ aur pani; base: Na₂Al₂O₄ aur pani

items: Basic oxides (group 1 aur 2, ionic) pani se alkalis dete hain; group 2 ki alkalinity neeche barhti hai.
Amphoteric Al₂O₃ HCl aur NaOH dono se react karta hai.
Acidic oxides (SiO₂, P₂O₃, P₂O₅, SO₂, SO₃; covalent) pani se acids aur bases se salt aur pani dete hain.
